title: The integer-multiplicity action is continuous under uniform convergence on a compact set that carries the carrier
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n), and let K ⊆ U be compact with Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let h_j (j ∈ ℕ) and h be continuous maps ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (n-covectors) with h_j → h uniformly on K. Then R.action(h_j) → R.action(h) as j → ∞, where R.action(g) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(g(x)) dHⁿ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → (∀ j, Continuous (hs j)) → Continuous h → TendstoUniformlyOn hs h atTop K → Tendsto (fun j => R.action (hs j)) atTop (𝓝 (R.action h))
